profile.headline: Research and Technology Computer Scientist and Engineer
profile.summary:
I have been working in the areas of big data analytics, large scale data management, geospatial data processing, cloud computing, distributed computing, parallel computing, peer-to-peer system, multimedia streaming, and fault-tolerant systems. I have 40+ publications with 1200+ citations in international conferences, international journals, book chapters, and patents (more in Google scholar, https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=u6fQZTcAAAAJ&hl=en). I have contributed as a program committee, a chair of international conferences, and an external reviewer for conferences and journals.

Also I have hands-on experiences on processing platforms and storage systems such as Storm, Hadoop (MapReduce), ElasticSearch, Clouds and HPC infrastructures (Amazon EC2/S3/SQS/Elastic MapReduce, Microsoft Azure, Rackspace, TeraGrid, FutureGrid, PlanetLab), NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, HBase), and relational databases (Oracle, Postgres, PostGIS, MySQL, Informix). I have been programming using mostly Java and C, also using Python and R, and worked on web programming and parallel programming.

projects.title: Multi-Application Predictive Analytics
projects.description:
Algorithms and automatic feature selection methods for predicting delinquency and default risk for multitude of loans (student, mortgage, auto etc.). Capability to handle thousands of features and automatically prioritizing them and deriving other indicators of risk. Capability to assess risk with a multitude of proprietary and open models (HMM, Regression, Decision Trees/Random Forest/Bayesian, Support Vector Machines). Large scale infrastructure based primarily on Cloudera Hadoop - Hadoop2.0/Hive/Talend/neo-4j/mongoDB/Hbase/Impala. Developed capability and IP prescribe actions and operationalize the actionable decisions. 
Some achievements:
- More than 10 Patent Applications
- 5+ academic publications
- 2 live pilots
- prediction accuracies of over 80-95% 
- predictions and prescriptive analytics enabled a 30%+ drop in delinquencies and defaults for multiple big bank client pilots
- large cross-site global research and commercialization effort with multiple data scientists, business counterparts and partner organizations
- led to the Xerox Adaptive Risk Management platform (offered as part of Xerox financial services capabilities)
